_note: Chinese for the messages GlobalPoint's own game code shows (as3/starpoint/*.as), for the Chinese game app: patch_cn_storage_dropoff.cjs and patch_cn_server_file.cjs with --zh (as3_source.cjs) replace each English piece with its Chinese one before compiling. "Finding game files… " + files.length
